result.title: ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?
result.summary: Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

AI.brief_summary: 审计19个公开多图基准约3.3万题，发现24.2%的题仅凭单图或问题本身即可作答，且MLLM普遍采取这种「单图捷径」，即使单图不足也会重复单图答案；据此筛选出1.87万题构建ASTERISM基准与难例子集，并提出跨图信用分配CICA，在RLVR中把奖励分配到真正需要多图证据的token上，三个开源MLLM上提升2.6–6.0分。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作直接诊断模型是否真正整合跨图视觉证据，并给出训练期的贡献分配方案，与「答案是否使用视觉内容」「视觉证据筛选」「贡献分配与监督」高度相关；但CICA作用于输出token的奖励分配而非latent推理状态，其机制是否可迁移到LVR仍需核查原文。
